name: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
title: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
summary: WorldBridge generates coherent and controllable 3D worlds from scattered, low-overlap images by encoding references into a global scene context and using attention and latent-reference consistency optimization.
